title: Newly predicted halide perovskites Mg3AB3 (A = N, Bi; B = F, Br, I) for next-generation photovoltaic applications: a first-principles study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5766-5780
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA09093D, Paper
Open Access

Mayeen Uddin Khandaker, Hamid Osman, Shams A. M. Issa, M. M. Uddin, Md. Habib Ullah, Hajir Wahbi, M. Y. Hanfi
The research examines the exceptional physical characteristics of Mg3AB3 (A = N, Bi; B = F, Br, I) perovskite compounds through density functional theory to assess their feasibility for photovoltaic applications.
